description: Ex-Soviet Air Force; registered CCCP-11985; passed to the Aktyubinsk Higher Civil Aviation Flying School as an instructional airframe after withdrawal; with the military school (AVVAU/VI SVO) from 1996; repainted into Kazakhstan Air Defence Forces colours and given bort "18 yellow"; the original Soviet registration is the true identity and the yellow 18 is a post-1996 marking

Built February 1971; delivered 6 April 1971; registered 26 May 1971 as CCCP-87590 to the Kazakh Civil Aviation Directorate at Zhana-Semey; to the Aktyubinsk flying school 1 April 1975; struck off 25 December 1987; first plinthed near the school grounds; wore a spurious UN-87590 applied in 2000; later moved to the museum line and repainted in Kazakhstan Air Defence Forces colours as "19 yellow"; year_built taken from the registry's stated build month
